environment.description: Same application deployed on identical infrastructure but with AWS WAF WebACL (id: acl-7f3a9b2e) attached to the ALB. The WebACL contains three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 100 - AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule action override set to COUNT (not block), CrossSiteScripting_QUERYSTRING in BLOCK, (2) Priority 200 - AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in default action (BLOCK) and sensitivity level set to HIGH — this evaluates query string parameters, URI path, and body using SQLi detection with transformations TEXT_TRANSFORMATION: URL_DECODE, HTML_ENTITY_DECODE, COMPRESS_WHITE_SPACE, (3) Priority 300 - custom rate-based rule limiting to 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm SQLi rule group matches are actively blocking (avg 47 blocks/day in production). The SQLi rule group specifically inspects the 'value' query parameter content against its signature database which includes UNION-based, boolean-blind, time-based, and stacked query injection patterns.
